root=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin
for rel in 'logs_tier.txt' '.ufo/l0-recovery-20261015T054007Z/stop-verification.json' '.ufo/interactive-l1-20261015T050057Z/surface/kake.txt'; do
  printf '\nPATH %s\n' "$rel"
  if [ -e "$root/$rel" ]; then printf 'test -e: present (exit 0)\n'; else printf 'test -e: absent (exit 1)\n'; fi
  printf 'HEAD tree entries: '
  git -C "$root" ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD -- "$rel"
  intro=$(git -C "$root" log --diff-filter=A --format='%H' -1 -- "$rel")
  printf 'introducing commit: %s\n' "${intro:-none}"
  if [ -n "$intro" ]; then
    git -C "$root" merge-base --is-ancestor "$intro" refs/remotes/origin/master
    rc=$?
    printf 'intro ancestor of refs/remotes/origin/master: exit %s\n' "$rc"
  fi
  deleted=$(git -C "$root" log --diff-filter=D --format='%H %s' -1 -- "$rel")
  printf 'latest delete commit: %s\n' "${deleted:-none}"
done
